subordinate_os.name: Release OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: release execution, certification and release evidence

subordinate_os.name: Storage OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: storage preservation, capacity, retention and restore evidence

subordinate_os.name: Host OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: host maintenance, service inventory and native safeguards

subordinate_os.name: Recovery OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: bounded and tested failure recovery and rollback

subordinate_os.name: Central Command OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: human owner delegated queue, evidence, review, priority and six-lane dispatch; never doubles as the runtime agent scheduler

subordinate_os.name: Deployment OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: versioned component scope admission and release-phase coordination; Release OS remains actual executor

subordinate_os.name: Orchestra OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: workflow DAG planning, leases and handoffs; reuse Central queue, don't create new release authority

subordinate_os.name: Agent OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: bounded single worker lifecycle, tools, state, sandbox, permissions, verification and expense budgets

subordinate_os.name: Swarm OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: coordinated fleet scheduling, isolation and adversarial reviews with measured 6-to-1000 promotion

subordinate_os.name: WoloChain OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: read-only chain health, RPC/consensus/indexer/bridge lineage and independently proven mainnet reconciliation; custody remains separate

supervisory_roles.name: System Shepherd
supervisory_roles.note: Not yet independently proven autonomous or independently registered as an OS.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Performance OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: May alias Speed OS; never silently count twice.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Renaissance OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: Existing read-only visual integration overlay, separate documented title; decide if subordinate OS or a facet.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Code Health OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: Working scanner module; OS authority needs review.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Council OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: Existing feature; decide whether belongs to Central Command.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Loop Engine / Loop OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: Likely Agent OS feedback control submodule; not yet a separate OS.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Graph / Provenance OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.issue: Cross-cutting dependency evidence; not automatically an independent OS.

rules: This is a proposed normalized roster, not a census of every branded module across all AoE2WAR repositories.
OS classification requires unique owner, authority, executable contract, evidence, recovery and measured value.
Do not count Doctor or Shepherd as OSs. Do not count umbrella as its own subordinate OS.
Public system-agent cards are source projections; unknown worker activity is not running.
New systems reuse existing code, storage and receipts; no deletion/replacement just to rename.
Website deployment P0 never waits for this P3 registry. Wolo financial authority remains separate.
